pages.title: When the Wind Rises
pages.text: Dandelion · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Dandelion Tea Bag in a teapot with milk; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)The earth delights to feel your bare feet, and the winds long to play with your hair.$(br2)— Kahlil Gibran, The Prophet

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: Instantly clears up to 3 negative effects and grants Slow Falling.$(br2)$(br2)Purge instant, Slow Falling 1:30
